author: toketrain
body:
Middle Earth

This is a map me and TravelerRudy made (yes, again :P). It's based on The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, of course! There's a mine, of course, chests, a functioning .yml, and in the middle of the map is the Lonely Mountain. You can see the map for yourself below. 
Images

Download {version 1.2}
v1.1
-Put the One Ring in the middle, made it cooler

v1.2
-Made the middle less op
-Changed a couple chest contents to make entire map gameplay better

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: One thing to think about - I am sure this is by design, but the center is way OP ( don't get me wrong I love OP game-play, but... ). I am not sure I could be stopped if I got  the Pro 4 diamond chest and the power III Flame I and Punch II bow and Notch Apple... I would 100% for sure build up so I could jump to the middle, get the bow ( Stomper kit or Rogue Kit either would work ), then tunnel down to get the chest items..  It would take about 10 sec to drop down get the bow, dig down get the chest and go invisible if I were not already.  If someone were at the bottom, All I would need to do is use that bow and knock them into the lava, they would have no chance as the lava is all around with no rails. I would first get the Knockback hoe, in-case someone else were to have the same Idea ( Rogue  would be best for this to take the bottom or the top) - All of this is without using the Notch apple...  Just some thoughts, I like the Quad Design and the Movie/book idea to build after.  :) +1
